note: Fails if the mode rules loosen: no mode, two modes (the later one in the order value_set, classification, code is named), `label` without `code`, a malformed hash and `q` beside `code` are each a located 422 invalid_parameter; an absent value set is a 404 `not_found` carrying the hash; `classification` takes only a class version, so a variable's pid is `invalid_ref` (no class versions exist until D), and a bare name two entities share is `ambiguous_ref` and a malformed `cursor` `invalid_cursor` (the last two steps; the MCP equivalence test requires each operation's cases to reach every declared code the fixtures can produce).
